_README: Hand-labeled retrieval evaluation set for Q6 (RAG chunking quality).
`relevant` entries are matched against each RetrievalHit's patent_no
A hit counts as relevant if it matches ANY entry in `relevant`.
Cases are derived from backend/patent_db/seed.py DEMO_PATENTS.
WARNING: with EMBEDDING_BACKEND=mock the embeddings are deterministic
SHA-256 hashes, so absolute recall/MRR numbers are near-random and
MEANINGLESS as a quality signal. The harness's value is the MECHANISM
(CI gate + per-case failure surfacing); it becomes a real quality
measurement the moment EMBEDDING_BACKEND=bge-m3 is configured.
